notes.title: Debris is not only Debris anymore
notes.content:
Well, as everyone knows the main game is not there all these things.
The development took a turn, failed to deliver everything promised and the game returned to the table.

Still we apply a 2em1 mod now, which will have an "adult" part to relax the souls of the galera while we finish correcting the shit that was done.

Thanks for the understanding, in a few months we came back with updates and improvements in the main game.

Update Notes:
- Hentai mode.
- Music.
- More bugs to fix.
- Automatic mode in Hentai mode.
- Lots of fun, if you know what i mean.

Thank you for not understanding and understanding.

Vlw
